name: Glittering Depths
description: A subterranean cavern illuminated by massive veins of raw, pulsing mana crystals.
visualTheme: Glowing blue and pink cavern halls where crystalline stalactites chime softly from cave wind.

history.createdWhy: Formed by geothermal pressure and concentrated environmental mana pools.
history.builtWho: Explored by early miners who fled when elemental creatures awakened.
history.majorEvents: The Great Collapse trapped several mining crews, now whispered to be ghosts.
history.whyExists: Source of raw crystals used to power the Kingdom's defenses.
history.currentConflicts: The local cavern fauna has mutated from feeding on raw magic.

ecosystem.weather: Chilly cave dampness with hum of magic

npcs.name: Prospector Grim
dialogue: A beauty, ain't it? Just don't tap the red ones too hard.
Raw mana crystals fetch a nice coin, but they attract nasty beasts.
Mind the chasms. Some holes don't have a bottom.

secrets.name: Hidden Geode
secrets.description: A pocket geode of pure, unstabilized magic crystals.
